method: Fresh retrieval of all indexed major/option requirement sections and their 156 linked degree roadmaps.
Compared academic text against the previous source captures; the only changed text was an admission-heading typo in the Linguistics/TESL blended page.
Independent source-directive/alternative-pool comparison, required-credit overcount checks, option-specific footnote review, and cross-checking semester references.
Regression tests cover known corrections and exercise all 265 program entries. Tests do not establish graduation eligibility.
known_limits: This is a public planning snapshot, not a CSUN degree audit or verified registration schedule.
No linked four-year degree roadmap is exposed by the program pages and central 2026 roadmap index for 17 entries; this does not establish that CSUN publishes no other advising material.
107 minor entries and course-page descriptions/prerequisites are retained from the previous snapshot rather than freshly recrawled in this review.
360 course records have no confirmed individual course page in the snapshot; program-only/retired/variant references retain explicit review warnings.
Placement, grades, admissions, repeat topics/enrollments, residency and approved substitutions still require student or department confirmation.
Sample semester positions are advisory. The selected timeline, verified prerequisite rules, and explicit user choices govern the generated plan.

source_discrepancies.finding: The roadmap places the math alternative and COMP 110/L together; the course page requires prior qualifying math credit. The mapper enforces the course prerequisite and flags the source conflict.

The source lists 57 lower-division plus 63 upper-division units, alongside a 71-unit major summary and embedded GE/campus coverage. The mapper retains the listed curriculum; published summary figures are not used to delete courses.

refinement.semester_loads: Roadmap semester totals are soft recommendations. Manual and automatic regular-semester loads have an 18-unit ceiling, with lower custom maxima supported. Shorter plans never invent overloads; insufficient capacity is flagged. Summer is capped at 13, winter at 4.
refinement.CIT_domain: A panel above Year 1 selects all-department domain packages or strictly eligible COMP/CIT 300–599 electives. Appropriate minors replace the extra block. CS and IS minors are disabled for CIT. Package approval, lower-division limit, GE non-overlap, excluded course families and combined 488 credit cap are enforced.
refinement.credit_accounting: Checked GE/campus areas receive a conservative planning-credit estimate after removing major/waiver/completed-course overlap. A transcript total replaces that estimate. Overlays create no extra earned units.
refinement.degree_electives: Only the remaining degree-credit balance is assigned to free electives. Unreconciled program credits above the guide’s free-elective budget are held as program review, not offered as unrestricted electives.
refinement.course_overlap: Existing eligible major/minor/preparation courses are automatically allocated to remaining GE. Course components are merged across lecture/bundle aliases, with completed components excluded from future loads.
roadmap_mapping_corrections: Computer Engineering’s guide was incorrectly associated with Civil Engineering; it now belongs to Computer Engineering.
Added Geography and Environmental Studies from the central 2026 four-year roadmap index. The separate Honors map is not exposed as an ordinary-major guide.
